segments.he: בְּיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן אַחַר פֶּסַח הָיִיתִי לָהוּט מְאד לִשְׂכּר סְפִינָה, אֲבָל הָיָה מִן הַנִּמְנָע כִּי הָיָה אָז הַחֲגָאוֹת שֶׁלָּהֶם שְׁלשָׁה יָמִים רְצוּפִים:
segments.en: And I took him and carried him. And he zichrono livracha — his head and most of his body rested upon me, and his feet touched the ground only slightly. And he was borne upon me until I brought him to his bed — which was not far from the chair.
